unit.why: A short narrative: during the Passover seder the Maggid (of Kozienice) has a vision of a youth who strikes him playfully and vanishes, and R. Levi Yitzhak of Berdichev identifies the youth as Elijah.

stories.start_quote: עוד שם המגיד בהגדה ש"פ התלהב מאד
stories.summary_en: While reciting the Haggadah on the Passover night the Maggid burned with fervor and saw a young man who stood before him, struck him playfully with his staff and vanished; he then travelled to R. Levi Yitzhak in Zelechow, who told him Elijah had visited him.
